content.value_statement: Default Markdown renderers can limit application-specific layouts and trusted custom tags. This skill guides scoped Vue component overrides that preserve nested Markdown and rendering behavior.
actual_capabilities: Classifies requests as built-in renderer overrides, trusted custom tags, or parser-level work.
Guides scoped component mappings with setCustomComponents and customId.
Identifies supported override keys, including image, link, code_block, mermaid, and d2.
Explains how to render nested Markdown inside trusted custom tags.
Lists props to preserve during component overrides and cleanup steps for temporary mappings.
limitations: It does not implement Vue components or edit project files automatically.
It covers Markstream customization and not low-level parser hook design.
Custom tags must be explicitly trusted and allowlisted by the application.
Behavior depends on the installed Markstream Vue version and project configuration.

use_cases.description: Replace image or link rendering for one documentation view without changing the whole application.

use_cases.title: Add trusted product callouts

use_cases.title: Stabilize diagram previews
use_cases.description: Customize Mermaid or infographic nodes while retaining preview height and loading behavior.

output_examples.input: Which key should I use to customize Mermaid diagrams?
output: Use the mermaid override key, not code_block.
Keep the mapping scoped with customId when only one renderer instance needs it.
Preserve estimated preview height for stable asynchronous previews.

output_examples.input: How do I support a trusted custom tag with Markdown inside it?
output: Add the tag to the customHtmlTags allowlist.
Map the same tag name to a scoped component.
Use a nested renderer for node.content and pass the same allowlist.

best_practices: Use scoped component mappings before global mappings.
Start with a leaf-node override before replacing a container node.
Validate repeated and nested custom tags with a focused local check.
anti_patterns: Do not use code_block when only Mermaid rendering needs customization.
Do not add untrusted tags to the custom HTML allowlist.
Do not omit cleanup for temporary scoped component mappings.

faq.question: What does this skill customize?
faq.answer: It guides customization of Markstream Vue node renderers and trusted custom tags.

faq.question: When should I use a scoped mapping?
faq.answer: Use one when an override applies to a specific renderer instance or Vue application scope.

faq.question: Can a custom tag contain Markdown?
faq.answer: Yes. Render node.content with a nested renderer and pass the same allowlist.

faq.question: Does this skill support parser transformations?
faq.answer: No. Parser-level transformations require low-level parser hooks outside this skill.

faq.question: What should I test after an override?
faq.answer: Test the smallest affected view and confirm repeated and nested tags render correctly.
